extraction.ownership_guide_prompt: Use case: background-extraction. Edit target: supplied original manuscript crop. Extract the complete finite blue ornamental line filler only, including its gold circular pip, two crossing pale diagonal rules, pale inner outline and entire original dark hand-painted outer border. Its left end bows inward in a shallow C-curve; keep that exact curved left edge and both original little pointed left corners, and the complete right terminal. Remove all manuscript paper outside the outer black painted contour, the dark lettering above/below/left, and the brown/gray page grime outside its curved left edge. Do not include page-stain patches as part of the band. Keep all original paint and gold highlights opaque inside the band, including worn pale paint. Actual transparent background, source proportions, unchanged uneven handmade original strokes and aged color/texture. No repaired straight rectangle, redrawing, new symbols, missing pip reflections, or crop through the border. Leave a little transparent padding.

parent_extraction.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit / background removal. Edit target: the supplied original medieval manuscript crop. Extract The three complete foreground hounds in the bottom margin: the small patched long-tailed hound at left, the pale middle hound biting the right hound, and the larger long-eared hound leaping up at right. These three drawings are dogs, without invented antlers. Include every tail, ear, limb and paw. Exclude all red/blue/gold decorative border, the person and initial painting above, writing, ghost marks and paper. Output the actual original illustrated artwork on a genuinely transparent background, with transparency in every genuine paper opening between limbs, figures and props. Preserve the exact source drawing, silhouettes, expressions, poses, hand gestures, anatomy, thin outlines, ink hatching, original colors and painted surface textures. Preserve pale illustrated skin and animal surfaces as opaque; remove only unpainted surrounding parchment, stains, all writing/ruling, reverse-side ghost images and photographic surroundings. No redrawing, modernization, beautification, extra characters, invented details, changed proportions, new shading, shadows, halo, page rectangle, disconnected paper fragments, or added background. Keep the original relative positions of the figures and original artwork facing. Retain every complete visible source tip, finger and toe with a small transparent margin. This is a faithful extraction of historical art, not a stylistic recreation.
